scope: Non-compat includes helper, customer, cards, exception, logger and abstract gateway implementations, including historical path loaders.
structural_fixes: Moved implementations to class-helper.php, class-customer.php, class-customer-cards.php, class-gateway-exception.php, class-logger.php and abstracts/class-payment-gateway.php; historical files are guarded require_once compatibility loaders.
Retained public camelCase methods and named arguments as documented aliases; implementation variables use snake_case.
Completed comments/docblocks, translated literal error messages before use, added translator context, and escaped localized thrown messages.
behavior_fixes: Card-display helpers unslash then run the existing typed Payment_Input card validation before token fields are read; invalid values cannot be persisted.
Customer email checks its type, unslashes once, and uses sanitize_email; existing local ID and hook contracts are retained.

Source and transaction lookup use the authoritative WooCommerce order store. HPOS supports native meta_query; CPT uses the documented scoped custom order-query mapping and removes the callback in finally.
Canonical fee/net zero values take precedence over stale legacy values. Updates remain staged for caller save; deletes immediately persist removal of both keys with save_meta_data.
Remote address input is unslashed, sanitized and validated as an IP before component encoding; valid IP request values are retained.
Logger elapsed time uses a UTC Unix timestamp; logger and exception still discard arbitrary payment diagnostic payloads.
Missing original-request identity headers now return false without undefined-key warnings.

validation.phpunit_baseline: Existing 80 tests / 593 assertions passed after owned runtime cleanup; focused HelperQualityTest subsequently passed 8 tests / 51 assertions after shared test doubles were added.
validation.real_wc_helper_checks: 13 assertions passed in posts and 13 in HPOS on WordPress 6.9 / WooCommerce 10.9.0 / PHP 8.4.13; unchanged worker assertions; no new PHP log bytes, stderr or financial HTTP.

security_boundary_evidence.fact: WooCommerce validates the add-payment-method nonce and logged-in user before calling the gateway helper.
WooCommerce applies woocommerce_order_data_store_cpt_get_orders_query after converting its supported custom query arguments to WP_Query arguments.
